grant.authorizationCode: The authorization code grant (RFC 6749 section 4.1): a code from the authorization endpoint, exchanged at the token endpoint.
grant.implicit: The implicit grant (RFC 6749 section 4.2): tokens straight from the authorization endpoint. RFC 9700 mode refuses it.
grant.refreshToken: The refresh token grant (RFC 6749 section 6). A client that declares grants without it is issued no refresh token.
grant.clientCredentials: The client credentials grant (RFC 6749 section 4.4): a token for the client itself, with no person.
grant.password: The resource owner password credentials grant (RFC 6749 section 4.3). OAuth 2.1 mode refuses it.
grant.tokenExchange: OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange (RFC 8693): a token exchanged for another, for delegation or impersonation.
grant.preAuthorizedCode: OpenID4VCI's pre-authorized code grant: a wallet redeems the code a Credential Offer carried.
grant.jwtBearer: A JWT as an authorization grant (RFC 7523 section 2.1). Off where oauth2.jwtBearerGrant is off.
grant.saml2Bearer: A SAML 2.0 assertion as an authorization grant (RFC 7522 section 2.1). Off where oauth2.saml2BearerGrant is off.
grant.ciba: OpenID Connect Client-Initiated Backchannel Authentication (CIBA): the person approves on another device. Off unless oauth2.ciba is on.
grant.deviceCode: The device authorization grant (RFC 8628): a device with no browser shows a code the person enters elsewhere. Off unless oauth2.deviceAuthorization is on.
grid.delegatedTip: Declared by a delegated permission grant of {permission} on {api}. It is not stored in oauthAllowedScope and cannot be removed here: change the delegated permission grant on the Permissions tab.
grid.generate.tip: Mint a client secret the way POST /oauth2/register does and put it in this box. Nothing is written until the application is created. Everything else you have typed on this page is kept.
find.boxTip: {kind, select, groups {Type part of a group's DN or name and press Find (or Enter): the realm's groups are matched as the Groups page's filter matches them, {n} to a page, leaving out the groups this list already holds.} parties {Type part of a username, or of an application's identifier or name, and press Find (or Enter): People are matched as the Users page's filter matches them, Applications as the Applications page's, {n} to a page, leaving out this application itself, which may not name itself.} policyApplications {Type part of an application's identifier or name and press Find (or Enter): the realm's applications are matched as the Applications page's filter matches them, {n} to a page, leaving out the applications this box already names. Add puts the application's identifier in the box; the profile's Save writes it.} other {Type part of an application's identifier or name and press Find (or Enter): the realm's applications are matched as the Applications page's filter matches them, {n} to a page, leaving out this application itself, which this list may not name, and the applications it already holds.}}
